children: August J. Troendle, a 10% owner and President & CEO, reported sales of common stock in two transactions executed pursuant to a limit order during an open window period. The reported prices are weighted averages of multiple trades, $620.84 for the 15,971 shares sold on 2026-09-15 and $621.29 for the 8,770 shares sold on 2026-09-16. The total proceeds reported for the sales were $15,364,148. Following the reported transactions, Troendle directly beneficially owns 515,153 shares and indirectly beneficially owns 4,733,019 shares via Medpace Investors, LLC.
